calibration.limitation: The pulse validates a known span. Excess includes busy-wait overshoot and scheduling, and omits some entry/exit bookkeeping. It is not a certified upper bound for every other timer. Deterministic tests use supplied clock values, not a physical overhead calibration.

inclusive_warming: Not stored. warm_generation is an exclusive aggregate over 17.57 to 19.29 calls per tick, not one inclusive call per tick. Child scope families are not attributed to their invoking routine.
denominator_limit: A retains raw E11 simulation durations and native CPU counters, not total busy wall time including the between-tick control prelude. Neither raw tick P99 nor main CPU is a safe upper bound for that missing wall quantity.
interpretation: No nonzero strict corrected lower bound above 5% follows from these retained data. Zero is a statement about the available proof, not an estimate of the feature cost.
